general_information.Syllabus Name: Digital Video Editing_Dựng phim kỹ thuật số
general_information.Description: The Digital Video Editing course aims to equip students with fundamental knowledge of the digital video industry. Students will learn to master the entire video production process, along with essential techniques such as scripting, filming, editing, post-production, and audio processing. The course introduces key stages of video production, including script development, production planning, editing, sound design, post-production, and the publishing of final products. Students will work with software such as Adobe Premiere, Adobe Audition, Adobe After Effects, and other supporting tools. The course also introduces several Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools used in the video production process, enabling students to explore and apply these advanced technologies to enhance the efficiency and quality of their media products.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be eligible for the final examination. 2. Actively participate in all class activities. 3. Fulfill all tasks assigned by the instructor after class. 4. Use their own laptop in class only for learning purposes. 5. Read the textbook in advance. 6. Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/gui/Home) for up-to-date information and course materials. 7. Complete the course portfolio with all required exercise contents and submit it to the instructor within one day after the course ends.
general_information.Tools: Required materials and equipment prepared by students: One A2-size folder. A3- and A4-size paper, and A1-size backboard paper. One smartphone or camera for video recording. Laptop. Video recording equipment.

description: The Digital Video Editing course aims to equip students with fundamental knowledge of the digital video industry. Students will learn to master the entire video production process, along with essential techniques such as scripting, filming, editing, post-production, and audio processing. The course introduces key stages of video production, including script development, production planning, editing, sound design, post-production, and the publishing of final products. Students will work with software such as Adobe Premiere, Adobe Audition, Adobe After Effects, and other supporting tools. The course also introduces several Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools used in the video production process, enabling students to explore and apply these advanced technologies to enhance the efficiency and quality of their media products.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Analyze scripts and content structure to identify hook, key moments, and retention strategy in video editing.
Break down creative briefs and transform them into storyboard and shotlist planning for post‑production.
Design editing strategies for different video formats including MV, Talkshow, and Podcast.
Apply professional editing workflows using industry tools (e.g., Premiere) without dependence on a single software.
Implement multicam editing techniques for talkshow and podcast formats.
Optimize video retention through pacing, highlight extraction, and cliffhanger editing.
Demonstrate professional teamwork, communication, and project management in video production workflows.

assessments.Grading Guide: In this lab, students will work in groups to produce a complete TV commercial (TVC) from concept to final edit. The project helps students master the video production process, practice editing with Adobe Premiere, and integrate AI tools for creating soundtracks or voice-overs. This exercise emphasizes both technical proficiency and team collaboration in a professional production workflow.

assessments.Grading Guide: In this final project, students will work in groups to produce a complete video on a topic of their choice, with a duration of 3–5 minutes. The project requires applying the full video production process from concept and scenario development to editing and final presentation. Students are expected to use Adobe Premiere proficiently to edit and enhance their videos and to leverage AI tools to improve video performance, such as generating effects, visuals, or enhancing footage. Each group will present their final project in class, explaining their workflow, creative choices, and the tools used.
